title: Loss of surplus if ERC-1271 order allows arbitrary data
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  [CoWSwapClone::isValidSignature()](https://github.com/Storm-Labs-Inc/cove-contracts-core/blob/6b607d137f898c0f421b4ba4e748f41b09b41518/src/swap_adapters/CoWSwapClone.sol#L86) do not check app data field.  This applies to all ERC-1271 orders where the app data field can be changed by an adversary in a way that keeps the signature valid for that order (for example, because isValidSignature ignores the appData field in the order).
